method: Preserve 24 existing repositories, then round-robin the first 100 GitHub search results in each category, deduplicated by repository ID; stop at 500.
limitations: Purposive, popularity-biased sample; not representative of all Python projects.
Search language/topic labels describe discovery, not verified code composition.
Selection groups are discovery buckets, not exclusive domain classifications.
Source coverage and observed activity must be measured separately from repository selection.

searches.query: language:Python topic:machine-learning archived:false fork:false stars:>=100 sort:stars-desc
